text:
Anna: Quick async check-in for this quarter's OKR milestones — please post a one-liner: shipped / slipped + short reason + owner + next step. Focus areas: Runtime, Dedicated, Private, Console, Optimize. Tag owners.

Sam: Runtime -> shipped: KV-prefix caching v1 behind feature flag. Perf looks good on med-length seqs. PR https://git.redwood/rt/PR/881. Owner: @Sam. Next: enable perf dashboard (grafana panel) by Tue. :thumbsup:

Mike: Eng-ML -> slipped: model quant test matrix failed on CUDA 12.2 base image, blocking fio runs. Root cause: dependency mismatch in transformer-kernel. Owner: @Mike. Next: bump base image and re-run tests, target EOD Fri. CR ping to @Sam for infra change.

Tina: Dedicated -> shipped: autoscale canary (10% capacity) in us-west. Observed slow drain on node termination (small error spike). Slipped: autoscale policy tuning to hit latency SLO. Owner: @Tina. Next: hotfix script + controlled canary expansion tomorrow morning. Filing ops ticket #4567.

Lina: Console / Product -> shipped: rollout UI for canary control and rollout history. Docs still pending (docs page + example playbook). Owner: @Lina / @Anna for playbook. Next: docs first draft by Wed, link to console: https://console.redwood/rollouts.

Sam: Also follow-up: need +2 reserved GPUs for large-load test next week (qtr load test). @Tina can we get capacity increase or a dedicated window?

Tina: @Sam yes, we can carve a window Mon 09:00-12:00 PT — I'll reserve capacity and coordinate infra.

Mike: CR ping: I pushed PR 1234 (quant-fix) — @Sam, @Tina, would appreciate quick reviews. Small change in base image and a unit test.

Sam: @Mike looking now, left one comment about env var handling. Nothing blocking.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed runtime-v3-kvcache to us-west-2 at 2934567900, health: ok, 0.2% 5xx spike during drain test.

Anna: Thanks all. Quick action items summary: 
- @Sam: enable perf dashboard panel for KV cache by Tue (owner: Sam).
- @Mike: bump base image + re-run quant tests, aim EOD Fri (owner: Mike).
- @Tina: hotfix autoscale drain script + reserve load-test window Mon 09:00-12:00 PT (owner: Tina).
- @Lina/@Anna: docs + playbook draft for rollout UI by Wed (owners: Lina/Anna).
- @Sam/@Tina: approve PR 1234 and infra sign-off (ongoing).

If anything else slipped that I didn't capture, drop a one-line update here. Otherwise I'll consolidate into the OKR board later today. :sparkles:
